newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 14.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 15 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia and Belarus can only be united if a single federative state is created with Belarus incorporated into Russia, says Nikolai Gonchar, an independent Russian deputy.
- Russia's badly cash-strapped health care system, strictly centralised in the Soviet times, is suffering a deep crisis in the regions.
- Russian oil company Rosneft has prepared proposals on production-sharing regulations for the development of a number of new oil deposits.
- According to a World Trade Organisation report quoted by Prime-Tass news agency, Russia is the only former Soviet republic among the leading 30 importing and exporting countries.
- The widely-heralded new stage of economic reforms, especially restructuring of natural monopolies, is likely to raise quarrels among the country's authorities.
